caption: MCP Task
description: Data associated with a task. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 Task).
name: mcp_task

mcp_created_at.description: MCP member `createdAt` (required by the protocol): ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was created.

mcp_last_updated_at.description: MCP member `lastUpdatedAt` (required by the protocol): ISO 8601 timestamp when the task was last updated.

mcp_poll_interval.description: MCP member `pollInterval`: Suggested polling interval in milliseconds.

mcp_status.description: MCP member `status` (required by the protocol): Current task state.

mcp_status_message.description:
MCP member `statusMessage`: Optional human-readable message describing the current task state.
This can provide context for any status, including:
- Reasons for "cancelled" status
- Summaries for "completed" status
- Diagnostic information for "failed" status (e.g., error details, what went wrong)

mcp_task_id.description: MCP member `taskId` (required by the protocol): The task identifier.

mcp_ttl_json.description: MCP member `ttl` (required by the protocol): Actual retention duration from creation in milliseconds, null for unlimited.

mcp_additional_members.description: Members the pinned definition does not name, exactly as reported, in source order.

mcp_nonconforming_members.description: Named members whose value does not fit the pinned definition, exactly as reported.
